name: Biometric Information Privacy Compliance (BIPA / CUBI)
description: Compliance framework for Biometric Information Privacy Laws (Illinois BIPA 740 ILCS 14, Texas CUBI, Washington Biometric Privacy Law), covering written biometric release consents, retention/deletion schedules, and zero-sale bans.

checklists.name: Biometric Privacy (BIPA / CUBI) Compliance Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Illinois BIPA Section 15 requirements and state biometric statutes.

items.statement: Written consent release is executed by the user prior to capturing facial geometry, fingerprints, or voiceprints (Sec 15(b)).
Publicly available written policy documents the retention schedule and guidelines for permanently destroying biometric data (Sec 15(a)).
Biometric data is destroyed upon satisfaction of initial purpose or within 3 years of last interaction, whichever occurs first.
Selling, leasing, trading, or profiting from biometric identifiers is strictly prohibited by software architecture (Sec 15(c)).
Biometric data is stored and transmitted using security controls at least as protective as other confidential financial data (Sec 15(e)).

reviewGates.name: Biometric Privacy Attestation Gate
reviewGates.statement: Legal Counsel confirms that biometric consent flows, public retention policies, and purge schedules satisfy Illinois BIPA and state biometric statutes.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the legal audit confirm full compliance with BIPA biometric notice, consent, and deletion rules?
